thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — severity: S2. Issue: higher-than-normal 5xx rate for hosted inference (us-west region). Auto-fallback engaged for a subset of requests.

alice (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping on this. Any initial impact numbers?

incident-bot: 5xx rate spike started at ~00:13 UTC, P50 latency up 2.1x, affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted). Approx 8% of requests failing with 502/503.

ben (sre): Confirming — telemetry shows a backend pool saturated (gpu-pool-uw1). I'm spinning a warm standby. Creating war room.

ben (sre): War room: https://meet.prod.redwood/warrooms/uw1-4975312222 (passcode: rw-uw1). Owner: dmitri (infra).

alice (oncall): On the war room. Paging dmitri now. @dmitri can you take lead for mitigation? If you need escalation to dedicated, call it out.

dmitri (infra): Taking owner. Investigating model-serving replicas + queue depth. Initial hypothesis: KV cache thrash after a cache invalidation event plus an autoscaler boundary.

carla (pm): Customer impact check: Which customers are seeing errors? Any high-SLA customers? I can prepare comms if we know scope.

ben (sre): Top affected customers are: AcmeAnalytics (api key ****A1), Playstream (****P2). No immediate enterprise-wide outage, but latency/502s for traffic routed through uw1.

maya (comms): I'll draft a status page entry and a short customer notification for impacted customers once we confirm scope. Draft below — please edit: 

---
Redwood status — Partial degraded service in US‑West (hosted inference) — Investigating. Some requests may see increased latency or 502/503 errors. We are actively mitigating and will provide updates every 20 minutes. Impact: subset of hosted API customers in us-west.
---

alice (oncall): Looks good. Add an ETA for next update (20m). Assign Maya to post.

maya (comms): Will post to status.redwood.com and send targeted emails to AcmeAnalytics + Playstream after ops confirms mitigation plan.

ben (sre): Mitigation steps: 1) scale up gpu-pool-uw1 by +2 nodes; 2) enable immediate routing fallback to uw2 for new sessions; 3) throttle noisy clients if they exceed burst thresholds. Implementing step 1 now.

dmitri (infra): Rolling scale request: using autoscaler override: 
``` 
PATCH /api/internal/pools/gpu-pool-uw1/scale
{ "desired": 8 }
```
Applying. Monitoring queue depth and error rate.

alice (oncall): Paging confirmed — please react with :white_check_mark: when each mitigation step completes. I'll keep the thread as the single source of truth for comms.

ben (sre): Node add started. ETA ~4m.

incident-bot: Autoscaler override accepted, requested nodes provisioning.

carla (pm): Customer comms note: include workaround: advise customers to retry requests (exponential backoff) and enable multi-region routing if they have it. I'll prep direct email.

dmitri (infra): Node add finished. Error rate down from 8% -> 2.3%. P50 latency trending down. Routing fallback to uw2 enabled for new sessions.

ben (sre): Throttling noisy keys: limiting AcmeAnalytics to 200 rps burst for 10m — they will be notified.

maya (comms): Posted initial status: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/4975312222. Draft email sent to Carters (Acme) and Playstream ops for review.

alice (oncall): Great. For the postmortem: collect evictions/kv-cache events and autoscaler logs. Owner for postmortem: dmitri. Ben — please tag me when you hand over stable state.

dmitri (infra): Will collect logs and start RCA thread. Moving to monitoring mode.

alice (oncall): Closing pager to active monitoring. Next update scheduled in 20m or sooner if regressions. Thanks all :heart:
